title: Chronic kidney disease: SGLT2 inhibitors for risk reduction
scope: Week 07, CKD risk reduction. One guideline document and one directly supportive original RCT. Research-stage educational draft; not clinically approved or a treatment directive.

documents.highlight: KDIGO 2024 recommends SGLT2 inhibition for adults with CKD when eGFR is at least 20 mL/min/1.73 m2 and urine ACR is at least 200 mg/g (recommendation 3.7.2, grade 1A). The guideline also offers a separate heart-failure indication, which is outside the selected X1 comparison.
documents.locator: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline, Section 3.7, Recommendation 3.7.2, Kidney International 105(Suppl 4S), p. S159; DAPA-CKD discussed in supporting narrative; Heerspink et al. cited in guideline bibliography.
documents.x1_linkage_status: direct_support_verified_for_albuminuric_CKD_subpopulation; DAPA-CKD enrolled eGFR 25-75, not full >=20 range or heart failure without albuminuria

x1.linkage_note: DAPA-CKD directly supports SGLT2 inhibitor benefit in albuminuric CKD with eGFR 25-75, a subset of Recommendation 3.7.2. This is one supporting pivotal primary trial, not proof of the entire eGFR>=20 or heart-failure arms of the recommendation.

picot.P: 4,304 adults with CKD (with or without type 2 diabetes), eGFR 25-75 mL/min/1.73 m2 and urine ACR 200-5000 mg/g.
picot.I: Dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily added to standard CKD treatment.
picot.C: Matching placebo added to standard CKD treatment.
picot.O: Composite of sustained >=50% eGFR fall, kidney failure, or renal/cardiovascular death: 197/2152 (9.2%) vs 312/2152 (14.5%); HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.51-0.72), NNT 19 (95% CI 15-27) over follow-up.
picot.T: Median follow-up 2.4 years; randomized double-blind trial stopped early for efficacy.

x1.limitations: No direct randomization evidence for eGFR 20-24 or nonalbuminuric CKD in this specific trial; stopping early may affect estimated benefit and event precision. Guideline generalizes from several RCTs and meta-analyses, not DAPA-CKD alone.
